theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Materials (+1.21%) and Communication Svcs (+1.17%) led the market today, while Real Estate (-1.12%) and Utilities (-0.07%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.69%, defensives +0.43%, and value/cyclicals +0.31% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.66%, Dow +0.18%, Nasdaq +1.05% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.50%. The VIX rose 1.37% to 15.52, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.15% to $4,165.60, crude oil was little changed at $89.61, and bitcoin slipped 0.04% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
